title: mentha × rotundifolia f. macrostachya
intro: Mentha × rotundifolia f. macrostachya, commonly known as Corsican mint, is a hybrid species of mint plants that combines the characteristics of Mentha rotundifolia and Mentha aquatica. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, relieve nausea, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Corsican mint include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Corsican mint include menthone, limonene, and beta-pinene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
